title: Component of compact-support system refinement composition
statement: theorem systemRefinement_comp_component (X Y : CondensedERealization.Base k) (f : X.scheme ⟶ Y.scheme) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] {c d e : Compactification f} (r : c.Refinement d) (s : d.Refinement e) (M : coefficientSequenceDerived.{u, u} l E X.scheme) : (systemRefinement l E k X Y f (r.comp s)).app M = (systemRefinement l E k X Y f s ≫ systemRefinement l E k X Y f r).app M

proof.text: Expand both pasting words at M. The two gamma mates compose by the proper/open mate cocycle, while the sComp and associator factors cancel by compositor associativity. This is the component equality used to obtain the natural-transformation equation by extensionality.
